messages:
Caroline: Quick kick — we're assembling the Orbit QuickDeploy refkit for cloud partner listing. Need: terraform module, single-file quickstart (3 cmds), CI smoke, marketplace metadata, two diagrams. Target: staging alpha next Tue.
Devin: I'll scaffold the TF module and a minimal example. Plan: modules/orbit, examples/minimal, examples/full. Will include a providers note and required_version.
Harpreet: I'll draft the ref-arch doc + diagrams (logical + ops). Will include a 1-paragraph "what to watch" and an alerts YAML snippet.
Jordyn: I'll own CI and packaging lint. Suggest GH Actions smoke job to run `terraform init`, `validate`, and `fmt -check`. Also add a small matrix for x86/arm to catch Graviton issues.
Devin: CI snippet for quick checks I propose:
```
name: quick-deploy-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [x86, arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
      - run: terraform fmt -check
```
Harpreet: Marketplace rules reminder: blurb <=200 chars, icon 64x64 PNG, screenshots scrubbed. Also include LICENSE + contributor guide. I'll prepare a short blurb draft.
Caroline: can we add a pre-commit hook with tflint and fmt? keeps merges clean.
Jordyn: yes — adding .pre-commit-config and a GH Action step to run `pre-commit run --all-files` as gate.
Devin: I'll include a tiny `terraform.tfvars.example` so CI plans quickly and doesn't require secrets.
marketplace-bot: NOTE: upload packaging assets to /partner-artifacts and run `./tools/validate-marketplace` before requesting staging publish.
Caroline: timeline: today set owners. Fri - module PR + README. Mon - CI + assets. Tue - staging publish + 30m smoke window.
Harpreet: I'll push diagrams and the quickstart tonight and link to the PR.
Jordyn: I'll stub the GH Action tonight so CI runs on PRs. I'll take final sign-off if CI + staging smoke pass. :thumbsup:
